caption:
A software billionaire just gave his old engineering college Rs 75 crore. For the second time.

Anant Yardi, a 1968 graduate of IIT Delhi who moved to the US and founded Yardi Systems, pledged a fresh Rs 75 crore gift in March 2026 - matching a previous Rs 75 crore pledge to the same institute years earlier. Most of the new gift goes to the Yardi School of Artificial Intelligence, which he originally endowed in 2020 and which now has more than 40 faculty members. The rest funds IIT Delhi's campus infrastructure renewal program.

He left IIT Delhi in 1968 to build a career in American software. He's come back twice since, each time with another Rs 75 crore.

Sources: Careers360, Free Press Journal (2026)
